verdict.rationale: Slate is itself an AI agent. Its docs show delegating tasks through natural-language prompts, such as having it review a codebase and write ARCH.md. They also document queuing and steering messages, spinning up parallel background subagents shown as inspectable cards, built-in `goal` and `deep-research` workflows, and permission controls for delegated actions. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably; the only community item questions the quality of one showcased port without showing a failure.
